description: NaLaMnWO₆ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁ space group. Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.95 Å. La is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of La-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.70 Å. W is bonded to six O atoms to form WO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent MnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 24-34°. There are a spread of W-O bond distances ranging from 1.87-2.09 Å. Mn is bonded to six O atoms to form MnO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent WO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 24-34°. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 2.13-2.26 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one W, and one Mn atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂MnW tetrahedra. In the second O site, O is bonded to two equivalent La, one W, and one Mn atom to form distorted corner-sharing OLa₂MnW tetrahedra. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one La, one W, and one Mn atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one La, one W, and one Mn atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent La, one W, and one Mn atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent La, one W, and one Mn atom.
